description: End-to-end test script for OAuth client administration using Playwright, testing client status management, UI interactions, and database state verification.

methods.name: expectClientStatusInDb
methods.description: Polls the database to verify the OAuth client's status matches the expected status.

methods.name: waitForAdminSection
methods.description: Waits for a specific admin section to become visible on the page.

methods.name: expectClientInAdminSection
methods.description: Checks that a specific OAuth client appears in the designated admin section.

methods.name: expectClientNotInAdminSection
methods.description: Checks that a specific OAuth client does not appear in the designated admin section.
